digest.component_or_area: verify policy enforcement and lifecycle acceptance
propositions: Rebar project must enable both enforce_plan_material_pins and require_plan_review_for_close policies while library defaults remain false without requiring migration or backfill

Public lifecycle test surfaces must prove direct and transitive material invalidation, dependency normalization, unchanged re-review non-propagation, and execution-phase self-edit invalidation until fresh review
Legacy unpinned attestations and pre-feature pinned targets must pass both policy gates without eager invalidation
Enable/disable/re-enable, in-progress reset, code-only drift at close, deleted/archived targets, concurrency, and audited force-close must be demonstrable through public lifecycle interfaces

Four concrete CLI gate-health cases must succeed with correct exit codes and user-visible remediation text when policies are enforced: legacy claim succeeds, current pins close succeeds, stale pin rejects with named target, incompatible-phase review rejects with review-plan instruction
No eager backfill, graph-wide invalidation event, new pin command, list-output schema change, or stored relation migration must be introduced
